home.title: Import-export company in Casablanca, Morocco

paragraphs: Our constant aim is to put our know-how at our customers’ service, with quality service and answers that meet their needs, both technical and commercial.

products.title: Our products
products.h1: Moroccan exports and imports into Morocco
products.lead: Two divisions: the Moroccan products we export, and the foreign products we import for Morocco. Add products to your quote request; if one is missing, ask us for it.
products.seoDescription: Exports: fish, seafood, canned food, olive and argan oil, fruit and vegetables from Morocco. Imports: metal cans, vegetable oils, canned food.

catalog.askTitle: Need a price or a data sheet?
catalog.askText: Add the products to your quote request, or call us directly.

services.title: Services
services.lead: As an import-export trader, ALIOM TRADING exports Moroccan products abroad, supplies Morocco with imported products and supports brands that want to grow there.
services.seoDescription: Import-export company in Morocco: Moroccan exports, imports into Morocco, supplier sourcing, quality control, logistics and brand representation.

items.title: Export
items.text: Seafood, canned food, oils, citrus, fruit and vegetables: we supply foreign importers with Moroccan products, by the container or in lots.

items.title: Import
items.text: Metal cans, vegetable oils, canned food: we supply Moroccan manufacturers and distributors and coordinate transport, customs clearance and delivery.

items.title: Supplier sourcing
items.text: We find and select the producers that match your specification, in Morocco and abroad, and compare the offers for you.

items.title: Brand representation
items.text: We represent international brands in Morocco: prospecting, presenting to distributors, following up orders and customers, and reporting market information.

items.title: Quality control
items.text: Plants selected against HACCP, IFS and BRC requirements, pre-loading checks and independent inspection on request.

items.title: Logistics and documents
items.text: Cold chain, containers, health and origin certificates, shipping documents: we prepare the file with you.

steps.title: Your need
steps.text: Product, specification, volumes, destination and timing.

steps.title: Our selection
steps.text: We consult our sources and propose the best offer.

steps.title: Inspection
steps.text: Quality, quantity and packing checked before departure.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: Transport and documents followed through to your warehouse.

services.brandsText: Looking for an agent to grow your sales in Morocco? Introduce your brand and products: we review every proposal.

about.title: About
about.h1: ALIOM TRADING: high standards in our customers’ service
about.lead: An agent for international brands, based at 2-4 rue Abou Dhabi, Oasis, Casablanca.
about.seoDescription: ALIOM TRADING, founded in Casablanca in 2021 by Habiba Ouliass: agent for international brands and import-export trader. Commitment, values and mission.
story: ALIOM TRADING grew out of long experience in distribution, as an agent for world-renowned brands.
Its founder, Mrs Habiba Ouliass, owns and manages the company, registered with the Casablanca trade register in 2021.
about.engagement: Quality is the source of our success: we meet HACCP, IFS and BRC requirements. This quality has been built over decades of expertise and through the full commitment and dedication of our team.

blocks.title: Our strengths
blocks.text: High-quality products at the best value for money, with respect for the environment. Our constant aim is to put our know-how at our customers’ service and give answers that fit their needs, technical and commercial alike.

blocks.title: Always available
blocks.text: We keep direct contact and an ongoing dialogue with our customers, wherever they are.

blocks.title: Product quality
blocks.text: We are always looking for the best products, through a demanding, expert selection of our suppliers and sources. We guarantee our customers product availability and reliable logistics.

blocks.title: Technical support
blocks.text: We provide effective technical support that listens and is always available to find solutions.

sections.p: ALIOM TRADING, single-member SARL with a share capital of MAD 500,000. Registered office: 2-4 rue Abou Dhabi, Oasis, Casablanca, Morocco. Casablanca trade register no. 502559. ICE: 002810898000009. Managing director and publication director: Mrs Habiba Ouliass. Contact: info@aliomtrading.com, +212 6 60 16 11 57.

Only what you type into the contact, quote and product request forms: name, company, e-mail address, phone number, country, the products you selected or are looking for, and your message.
We use this data to answer your request and, if you become a customer, to prepare and follow up offers and orders. Enquiries that do not lead to business are deleted after 24 months.
We do not sell your data. Form messages pass through our e-mail provider; logistics partners only receive what is needed for a delivery.
This website sets no tracking cookies. Your quote selection is stored in your own browser (local storage) and only sent to us when you submit the form.

Under Moroccan Law 09-08 on the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data, you have the right to access, correct and object to the use of your data. Write to info@aliomtrading.com.
